# Design system catalog

Everything here exists. Use it before writing UI by hand; extend it (in src/ui) when it lacks something.

## src/ui.rs

- `ui::Squircle` — Rounds an element with the design's soft squircle.
- `ui::set_density`
- `ui::set_switch_icons`
- `ui::density_pad` — UI density, the space between the server, channel and member lists: `default` is the Default density's padding or gap, about a quarter less 
- `ui::Tone`
- `ui::split` — A main action and its options chevron, joined: inner corners tighten to 4px with a 1px seam.
- `ui::scrolled` — Whether a list has scrolled down from its top.
- `ui::hard_edge` — A header with a hard edge over the list below it: a faint hairline along that edge shows once the list has scrolled under it.
- `ui::more_below` — A fade over the foot of a scrolling list while more of it lies below, dissolving into `fill` (the surface under the list); it goes once the 
- `ui::scroll_area` — A vertical scroll area moving `list` on `scroll`, with the kit's scrollbar over it.
- `ui::scroll_fade` — A list that scrolls inside a fixed box, its top and bottom edges fading into `surface` wherever there is more to scroll to: a short box of r
- `ui::truncating` — A one-line label that truncates with an ellipsis and, when it does, shows its full text in a tooltip.
- `ui::live_badge`
- `ui::badge` — A small solid label (quality, tags, NEW).
- `ui::tag` — What something is (App, Host, New): accent ink on the accent tint, uppercase 11px.
- `ui::tag_with` — A tag led by a small glyph (Host's crown).
- `ui::count_badge` — A count asks for you, so it takes the alert red.
- `ui::unread_dot` — Something unread, without a count.
- `ui::role_chip` — A role: its colour as a dot and a light tint of the capsule.
- `ui::pill` — The role chip's capsule, for a lead mark other than a colour dot (a permission's shield).
- `ui::kbd` — A keycap: the raised fill, a hairline ring and a deeper bottom edge, so it reads as a key you could press.
- `ui::kbd_translucent` — A key cap on a coloured fill (a danger button): a wash of `ink` with an inset edge, lettered in `ink`, so it takes the fill's colour instead
- `ui::kbd_glyph` — A keycap lettered with `glyph` (the arrow keys).
- `ui::key_hint` — What a key does, after its caps: "[Esc] Cancel".
- `ui::keys` — A shortcut: its keys side by side.
- `ui::shadow_pop` — What floats (menus, popovers, toasts): a long soft drop and a hairline ring in place of a border.
- `ui::shadow_pop_on` — The pop shadow with its hairline in `ring`, for a scope with its own line colour (the call stage).
- `ui::shadow`
- `ui::switch_live` — The switch: a wide pill with a capsule knob, honey when on (iOS-style).
- `ui::Check`
- `ui::check`
- `ui::check_live` — A checkbox that fades its fill and pops its tick in on the spring (200ms), as the design's does.
- `ui::radio` — Off: a thin ring.
- `ui::radio_with` — A radio at `size` (menus use 18) with its resting ring in `line`, for scopes with their own line colour.
- `ui::radio_live` — A radio whose band thickens on the spring when chosen.
- `ui::toggle_row` — A setting that applies at once: its title and a line of detail, the switch at the end.
- `ui::pick_row` — One of a set to pick from: the check or radio first, then its title and detail.
- `ui::pick_row_icon` — A choice whose kind has an icon (a channel type, a place): the icon leads the title, as in Create Channel.
- `ui::speaking_ring` — Speaking: a gap in the surface's colour, then the accent ring.
- `ui::avatar_stack` — Overlapping avatars, each ringed in `ring` (the surface colour) so they read apart.
- `ui::stacked` — Avatars of one `size` (photos, monograms, a "+3"), overlapped 6px and ringed in the surface's colour.
- `ui::capped_stack` — At most `cap` faces; past that the last slot becomes a "+n" chip in `more_fill`, so the stack stays a glance, not a roster.
- `ui::listed_stack` — A capped stack whose "+n" isn't a dead end: hovering it lists everyone, under `title`.
- `ui::surface` — A floating surface (menu, popover, picker): rounded, ringed and shadowed, with its content inset so nothing reaches the rounded edge.
- `ui::floating_bar` — A bar that floats over a page's foot (unsaved changes, bulk actions): the overlay card at the settings column's width.
- `ui::foot_dock` — Docks a floating bar 16px above the foot of the nearest relative parent, centred, rising in.
- `ui::rise` — A floating surface's entrance (menus, popovers, pickers, dialogs): it fades in and grows from 0.95 over the pop timing, after `delay` (a sub
- `ui::corner` — A transform origin at one of an element's corners: where a floating surface rises from, toward its trigger.
- `ui::Notice`
- `ui::callout` — An inline notice inside the view it's about: a tinted surface, a leading icon, a title and a line.
- `ui::callout_with` — A callout whose actions sit under its text (`actions` is laid out by the caller), for notices that offer more than one way on.
- `ui::toast` — A toast: one line (and an optional detail) on the floating surface, rising in over 240ms from 8px lower and 0.97.
- `ui::toast_with` — A toast with its one action (Undo) at the end.
- `ui::empty_state` — An empty or waiting state: spot art (the mascot, or an illustration where Discord leads with one), what's missing, and room for one action.
- `ui::Art`
- `ui::divider` — A divider, with an optional label naming what follows.
- `ui::seam` — A vertical hairline between groups in a row (toolbar sections, a header's controls), 20px tall with 2px clear either side; `.bg(..)` takes a
- `ui::inset_rule` — The hairline along a stacked section's foot, held in from the card's edges by `inset`.
- `ui::icon_tile` — A squircle holding an icon, for row leads and settings.
- `ui::bars` — The mini wave: three bars, the mark for speaking, typing, loading and live.
- `ui::bars_still` — The mini wave at rest (`.bars.still`): connected, in a call.
- `ui::bars_weak` — The resting wave with all but its first bar dimmed (`.bars.weak`): connected, on a poor link.
- `ui::media` — An image placed against a rounded container's edge, rounded to `corners` itself because gpui can't clip children to rounded corners.
- `ui::all` — Corner sets for `media` and edge strips: all four, or only the top or bottom pair.
- `ui::top`
- `ui::left`
- `ui::edge` — A strip (header, footer, scroll area) that runs edge to edge of a rounded container, rounded to match on the corners it touches, in the cont
- `ui::mix` — CSS `color-mix` in sRGB: `t` of `to` over `from`, for fills that follow a transition.

## src/ui/control.rs

- `ui::Control`
- `ui::button` — A text button, 36px tall (`.large()` 44, `.small()` 30).
- `ui::icon_button` — A square icon-only button that fills on hover, with its tooltip: 32px (`.small()` 24, `.large()` 40).
- `ui::icon_slot` — An icon button whose face is any element instead of a glyph (a server's tile in a picker's category rail, an svg nav icon): the same size, f
- `ui::round_button` — A round icon button over video or the call stage (`size` 28 or 40).
- `ui::card` — A clickable card (a template, a post, a launcher entry, a theme): a quiet fill on the page that deepens on hover, rounded large; `.toggled` 
- `ui::chip` — A filter or toggle chip; pressed takes the accent tint and a half-accent edge.
- `ui::chip_lead` — A chip led by something other than a glyph (a forum tag's emoji).
- `ui::swatch` — A colour choice (role colours): a filled square, ringed and ticked when chosen.
- `ui::menu_row` — A row inside a floating surface (menu, popover, picker): no fill until hovered, then the hover fill and the strong ink fade in.
- `ui::pressable` — Any element with an id that shrinks to `to` while held, eased like a Control's press (gpui's `.active` style swaps in one frame).
- `ui::Pressable`
- `ui::hover_state` — Whether `key`'s element is under the pointer, held beside it so a change redraws only the view that draws it; pass the listener to that elem
- `ui::hover_fade` — How far `id`'s hover has faded in, 0 to 1, on the design's hover timing (150ms ease-out).
- `ui::tip` — A tooltip in the design's look, for `.tooltip(move |window, cx| ui::tip(text.clone(), window, cx))`.

- `ui::dialog` — A dialog's card around `body`, `width` wide.
- `ui::dialog_scroll` — The part of a dialog between its fixed header and footer that scrolls when the window is too short, fading out at whichever edge has more be
- `ui::dialog_body` — A dialog's usual body: 24px in, sections 16px apart.
- `ui::modal` — Dims the window behind `dialog` and centres it.

- `ui::avatar` — A photo avatar.
- `ui::dm_face` — A DM's face at `size` (design: navigation.html's .gav).
- `ui::monogram` — An avatar without a photo: the name's initial on a gradient picked from the name.
- `ui::name_hue` — The design's avatar hue: a stable hash of the name onto the colour wheel.
- `ui::gap` — The gap `spread` wide around a round mark or an overlapping avatar, separating it from what's under it.
- `ui::server_tile` — A server's icon as a squircle tile at `size`, or its initials on the selected fill when it has none.
- `ui::app_tile` — An app's icon as a server tile, or without one its initial on the monogram gradient, hued by `id` so an app keeps its colour whatever it's c
- `ui::status_mark` — A presence mark, bare: Discord's shapes, never colour alone (a dot for online, a moon for idle, a bar for do not disturb, a ring for offline
- `ui::MarkFill` — What an icon mark is filled with.
- `ui::Spot` — Where on a face a mark sits.
- `ui::Shape` — A face's outline, which decides where its corner marks land: on a round face a mark sits on the curve, tucked in; on a tile it hangs past th
- `ui::Badge` — One mark for a face's corner: any element, ringed by the face in its surface colour.
- `ui::badge_of` — A corner mark from any element (a count, an icon mark, a status), round unless given a `radius`.
- `ui::badged` — A face (avatar, monogram, server or app tile) ready to take corner marks; see `Badged`.

## src/ui/feedback.rs

- `ui::progress` — Progress: the done part, a 4px gap, then what's left.
- `ui::progress_live` — Progress whose done part grows to a new value over the panel timing rather than jumping.
- `ui::progress_indeterminate` — Work that can't be counted: a done-coloured stretch travels the track, gapped from the rest on both sides, on the design's 1.6s move curve.
- `ui::progress_bar` — Progress with options for its colours and weight; see `ProgressBar`.
- `ui::slider_track` — The slider's resting look, for screens that run their own drag.
- `ui::media_track` — The track of a scrubber or volume slider over video: a 4px wash of white, the accent filled to `fraction` and a white knob `knob` wide centr
- `ui::slider_live` — A draggable slider for a 0..1 value: press anywhere on the track to jump there, drag to follow, arrows step 1% (shift 10%) once it has focus
- `ui::meter` — The mic meter: `bars` equal bars that light up to `level` (0..1), turning amber then red near the top.
- `ui::meter_with` — The meter in a scope with its own colours (the call stage): `lit` is on, hot and clipping.
- `ui::ring` — A ring of two round-capped arcs, done and left, with a gap at each meeting point: 40px, 4px stroke.
- `ui::skeleton` — A loading placeholder: the selected fill with a calm shimmer that sweeps across, then rests.
- `ui::skeleton_circle` — A round placeholder for an avatar of `size`.
- `ui::squiggle` — A marker squiggle under where a jump landed.

## src/ui/field.rs

- `ui::field` — A labelled field: the label, then whatever the caller adds (a frame, a hint, an error).
- `ui::field_marked` — The same, with the danger-ink mark after a label the form can't go without.
- `ui::field_hint` — Help under a field, with an optional count or note at the far end.
- `ui::field_error` — What went wrong and how to fix it, under the field, led by the filled warning mark.
- `ui::field_frame` — The static frame of a text input (`.input`): 40px, the page fill, a strong hairline, 16px strong text.
- `ui::text_field` — The frame around a text input with its focus fade; focus takes the accent edge and ring.
- `ui::search_field` — The one search box: the regular input's size, edge-free on a translucent fill over a light blur (content scrolling under a header stays fain
- `ui::search_frame` — The same search box around an `Input` the caller has configured, e.g.
- `ui::search_button` — A button that opens a search somewhere else (the switcher), drawn as the search box with its label in the placeholder ink: no caret, a hover
- `ui::text_area` — The same frame for a multi-line input: at least 88px, 10px top and bottom.
- `ui::select` — A dropdown's trigger: the chosen value, a caret that turns over while its list is open, the accent edge.
- `ui::stepper` — A number nudged in steps: minus, the value, plus.
- `ui::code_cell` — One cell of a one-time code: 44x52, the digit in mono bold 20, the focus edge and ring on the cell typed next.
- `ui::drop_zone` — Where files can be dropped: a dashed edge that takes the accent while something is over it.
- `ui::select_options` — A select's open list, rising from under its trigger (`top` is the trigger's height); the chosen option carries a check (`dropdown`).
- `ui::check_options` — Options any number of which can be on, each with its checkbox; choosing one toggles it and leaves the list open.
- `ui::Align` — Which edge of its trigger a dropdown lines up with.
- `ui::menu_dropdown` — A menu surface of `rows` rising from under its trigger, which sits `top` px tall above it in the same relative parent; `align` picks the tri
- `ui::dropdown` — A floating panel under its trigger (`top` is the trigger's height), dismissed by a press anywhere else: a select's list, or a picker with it

## src/ui/group.rs

- `ui::settings_group` — A heading over a card; the caller adds the card and any caption under it.
- `ui::settings_caption` — The note under a group's card: what the settings above it affect.
- `ui::settings_warning` — A caption that warns: the settings above it currently have no effect.
- `ui::settings_card` — Rows on the raised surface, one step from the page with no border, inset so their fills clear its edge.
- `ui::SettingsHighlight` — The row a settings search just jumped to, lit for a moment (`settings_row` reads it).
- `ui::settings_row` — A row in a settings card: title and description first, the control last.
- `ui::settings_title` — A settings page's big title.
- `ui::settings_text` — A settings row's title with its muted description under it.
- `ui::settings_switch` — A settings row with a switch at its end; the whole row toggles (the caller adds `on_click`).
- `ui::settings_choice` — A whole-row control: the row fills on hover.
- `ui::settings_nav_item` — A settings window's nav entry: its icon, then its label; the open page carries the selected fill.
- `ui::settings_close` — Pinned top right as a settings page scrolls: a ringed circle with "Esc" under it.
- `ui::settings_window` — A settings window: its nav on the sidebar tone, then the page, over the whole app window.
- `ui::settings_sidebar` — A settings window's nav list, under its header strip (`settings_nav_edge`).
- `ui::settings_nav_edge` — The settings nav's header strip: the traffic lights sit over it on macOS, as in System Settings, and it drags the window.
- `ui::settings_page` — The scrolling column of a settings page: title, then its groups.
- `ui::SETTINGS_WIDTH`
- `ui::SETTINGS_NAV_WIDTH` — The settings nav column's starting width; it can be dragged wider or narrower.
- `ui::settings_column` — The centred content column a settings page's title and every group sit in.

- `ui::rich_line` — One line of styled text (a match highlight, bold runs) that ends in an ellipsis: `ui::line` for anything that isn't plain text.

- `ui::visible_rows` — The rows of a scrolled column worth building: those a view from `view_top`, `view_height` tall, shows, widened by `margin` either side.

- `ui::StripFill` — What an inline strip is filled with: the raised card with a hairline edge, the selected wash, or a tint of the accent.

- `ui::toast_text` — A toast of one line of text, with no lead glyph, rising in like `ui::toast`.
- `ui::number_mark` — A numbered disc, 24px, in the accent tint: a step's or a rule's number.

- `ui::panel` — A card that only holds things (a quoted embed, a preview): the raised fill, a hairline edge, rounded large, content in a column.

## src/ui/overflow.rs

## src/ui/roll.rs

- `palette::ink_on_light` — Strong ink on a fill that's light whatever the theme (a light profile theme, a pale brand tile).
- `palette::online_on_light` — Status green deepened to stay readable on a light profile card (the status green is ~2:1 there).
- `palette::qr_ink` — The QR code's modules: dark on white in both themes, or phones can't read it: oklch(0.22 0.004 260).
- `palette::media_badge` — A call's media badge on the rail while not connected: dark under white ink in both themes, as Discord draws it.
- `palette::window_close_hover` — Windows 11's caption red, not the app's danger tone: Close should look like every other window's.

- `palette::on_accent` — Text and icons on an accent fill.

- `palette::accent_press`

- `palette::success_tint`

- `palette::track`

- `palette::positive_ink`

## src/motion.rs

- `motion::spring` — Critically damped and quick (Apple's damping 1.0, ~220ms): settles without wobble and retargets from its live value, so it can be interrupte
- `motion::snappy` — SwiftUI's `.snappy` bounce (0.15) on `spring`'s 220ms: its own 0.5s read as slow.
- `motion::fold` — Folds are one block, height and fade together, on the house enter curve.
- `motion::back_out` — Ease-out-back: a one-shot pop for gpui's built-in animations, overshooting ~10% before settling.
- `motion::SHAKE` — A refusal's horizontal shake, in px at progress `t` of `SHAKE`: three swings that die out by the end.
- `motion::shake`
- `motion::ease_out` — The design's curves (design/tokens.css), for `gpui_kit::base::transition`: enter and exit, on-screen movement, and the touch spring.
- `motion::ease_move`
- `motion::ease_spring` — `--ease-spring` stop for stop: ~0.3 bounce that settles inside the duration it runs over.
